Prosecutions in 2025

First Greater Western (Twerton), sentenced 3 October 2025

Prosecution

Summary 

First Greater Western Limited were fined £1 million on 3 October 2025 for breaching health and safety legislation.

It followed a fatal incident near Twerton on 1 December 2018, when a 28-year-old passenger suffered a fatal head injury.

Company 

First Greater Western Limited (trading as Great Western Railway)

Breaches involved

  1. Health & Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, Section 3(1). 
  2. Railways and Other Guided Transport Systems (Safety) Regulations 2006 (ROGS), Regulation 19(1).

Date(s) of offence 

On and before 1st December 2018

Plea

Guilty

Result

Convicted under Section 3(1) of the Health & Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and Regulation 19(1) ROGS

Court

Bristol Crown Court

Sentencing date

3 October 2025

Penalty

£1 million

(Very Large Organisation – sentenced in Medium culpability / Harm Category 2 range)

Costs

£78,444.19

Location of offence 

Address: 

Railway routes operated by High Speed Trains with Mark 3 coaching stock

ORR details

Railway Safety Directorate
